summary.storyTitle: Story 6: Reopen and Degraded Source State
summary.implementedScope: Implemented Story 6 reopen/degraded-state behavior by making source read synchronization degrade per source instead of failing whole sections, adding bounded unavailable rendering in project and process source UI, and covering reopen/access-loss/degraded-read scenarios with story-scope tests.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: buildSourceAttachmentReadSummary redacts stale hydration and refresh metadata for unavailable rows.
Project and process readers serialize through the redaction layer.
New route-level TC-6.2a tests assert real GET payload redaction for project and process surfaces.

changedFiles.reason: Made project source synchronization degrade a single failing source to an unavailable row and clear stale refresh metadata instead of failing the whole read.
Rendered bounded unavailable state for project source rows without showing stale hydration details.
Rendered bounded unavailable state for process current-source rows without showing stale hydration details.
Added Story 6 coverage for reopening project source state and keeping healthy sources visible when one source lookup fails.
Added Story 6 coverage for reopening durable process current-source state.
Added Story 6 coverage for revoked-access blocking on source-management routes.
Added Story 6 coverage for safe unavailable-source rendering in project and process source UI.
